aboutHanli.title: About Hanli
aboutHanli.description1: We leverage the unique industry-university-research consortium of Chaowei Group and Wuhan University of Technology, dedicated to providing the world's leading new energy marine power system solutions for inland and coastal vessels, covering pure electric, hybrid power, and multi-fuel clean propulsion technologies including methanol, ammonia, and hydrogen.
aboutHanli.description2: Hanli New Energy focuses on providing green, efficient, and sustainable power solutions for inland and coastal shipping, covering green marine power system integration, multi-fuel hybrid engine R&D, multi-fuel supply systems, and ship energy storage systems. The company has the capability to adapt engines to diverse clean fuels such as methanol, ammonia, and hydrogen, driving a smooth transition of marine power from traditional fuels to low-carbon and zero-carbon energy.

hydrogenFuelSystem.title:
Hydrogen Fuel System
Product Series
hydrogenFuelSystem.description: This system pioneered flexible hydrogen liquefaction technology, abandoning traditional turbine expansion cycles and adopting independently developed high-power low-temperature refrigeration units. Production capacity can be dynamically adjusted between 20%-100%, enabling rapid liquid startup. Modular design results in compact equipment with flexible parallel expansion capabilities and high reliability redundancy. Core components include hydrogen liquefaction units, liquid nitrogen precooling units, refrigeration compressors, and liquid hydrogen storage tanks.

methanolFuelSystem.title:
Methanol Fuel System
Product Series
methanolFuelSystem.description: The methanol fuel system mainly consists of methanol loading units, methanol barge units, and methanol supply units as key modules. Additionally, it includes inert gas systems, air instrument systems, methanol emission systems, ventilation systems, and control monitoring & safety systems as subsystems. Through the coordination of various systems, it achieves safe storage and efficient supply of methanol fuel.

aboutPage.headerSubtitle: Focused on Marine New Energy Power System Solutions.
companyIntro: Hanli New Energy (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. (HANLY ENERGY) is a high-tech enterprise in the maritime new energy field jointly invested and built by Hong Kong-listed Chaowei Group and Wuhan University of Technology.

The company is anchored in the inland and coastal green shipping sector, with forward-looking technology layout for ocean scenarios, dedicated to providing lifecycle low-carbon and zero-carbon power systems and supporting infrastructure solutions for maritime ecosystem participants, fully empowering the green transformation of shipping.

The company possesses deep research and development genes, with the core R&D team led by the School of Naval Architecture, Ocean and Energy Power Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology. Relying on the university's research platform, the company has established an integrated mechanism of 'talent cultivation, scientific research, product development, achievement transformation, and standard setting', jointly participating with ship inspection institutions in industry regulation and standard setting, continuously creating industry-leading green maritime power technology and products.

With new energy maritime power system integration as its core, the company focuses on pure electric and hybrid power systems and supporting infrastructure solutions, providing customers with comprehensive lifecycle services including design consultation, R&D and manufacturing, system integration, engineering delivery, and after-sales maintenance. Integrating high-quality industry resources and building an integrated product matrix of power, electrical control, energy storage, power distribution, and fuel supply adapted to maritime scenarios, providing shipyards, vessel owners, and port operators with safe, stable, efficient, reliable, and clean integrated solutions, accelerating the low-carbon and zero-carbon transformation of the maritime industry.

In the future, the company will continue to be supported by core R&D technology and engineering delivery capabilities, using technological innovation to shape new productive forces in the maritime industry, and leading the innovative upgrade and high-quality development of the green shipping industry.

productsPageContent.heroSubtitle: Zero-pollution, high-efficiency, multi-protection energy solutions for the green shipping industry.
productsPageContent.introText1: Our core products and services span green marine power system integration, multi-fuel hybrid engine R&D, multi-fuel supply systems, and ship energy storage systems. We possess the capability to adapt engines to diverse clean fuels including methanol, ammonia, and hydrogen, enabling a smooth transition of marine power from traditional fuels to low-carbon and zero-carbon energy. Leveraging our advantages in modular and integrated system design, combined with our international technical team's professional expertise and localized implementation experience, we can provide customers with customized, high-performance, and highly reliable comprehensive power solutions tailored to different vessel types, operational scenarios, and environmental requirements.
productsPageContent.introText2: Against the backdrop of the dual-carbon goals and the global green transformation of shipping, Hanli New Energy drives technological innovation, actively responding to national green shipping policies and helping vessel owners and builders navigate increasingly stringent environmental regulations. We are committed to empowering the low-carbon and zero-carbon transformation of inland and coastal shipping in China and globally, striving to become a leading global provider of comprehensive new energy marine power system solutions and a core driving force for industry transformation.

productSeries.title: Ship/Shore Photovoltaic Energy Storage, Charging and Discharging Product Series
productSeries.desc: Targeting inland, near-coastal vessel navigation energy storage, tourism, anchoring, agricultural and forestry operations, emergency power supply, and port shore-based energy scenarios. Providing ship photovoltaic energy storage, domestic power supply, emergency power sources, charging/discharging systems, and integrated ship-shore zero-carbon energy storage and supply solutions. Supports intelligent charge/discharge management, enabling self-generation and self-consumption for vessels, green electricity supply for ports, and reduced port berthing energy costs.

productSeries.title: Fuel Supply Product Series
productSeries.desc: Targeting new construction and retrofitting of inland, near-coastal, and ocean-going vessels, providing fuel supply system modules (including methanol-powered ships, hydrogen demonstration ships, ammonia-powered ships, and multi-fuel hybrid ships). Covering comprehensive zero-carbon fuel solutions for methanol, hydrogen, and ammonia including ship-based 'storage-transportation-supply-recovery' safety solutions, adapting to different power routes and vessel zero-carbon requirements.

productSeries.title: Hybrid Power Product Series
productSeries.desc: Providing low-carbon/zero-carbon power solutions for multi-energy synergistic marine propulsion, covering all scenarios from 'short-distance high-frequency→medium-long range cruising→special operations'. Precisely matching different vessel types' power requirements. Hybrid power systems come in three configurations: series, parallel, and power-split, enabling flexible combinations of multiple energy and power sources to adapt to different application scenarios, improving vessel economics and flexibility while reducing energy consumption and emissions.

productSeries.title: Ship/Shore Energy Control Product Series
productSeries.desc: Targeting marine power distribution systems (DC + AC distribution cabinets), port shore power pedestals, and ship shore power connection devices. As the 'energy distribution hub' of ship electrical systems, providing safe and efficient power distribution and management solutions for ship propulsion systems, energy storage equipment, and electrical terminals, along with shore power connection and intelligent power management solutions for ship berthing.

solutionsPageContent.heroSubtitle: Hanli New Energy - Full-Range Electric Propulsion System Solution Provider, Empowering Zero-Emission Ship Transformation
solutionsPageContent.sectionSubtitle: Hanli New Energy provides comprehensive battery-powered and hybrid propulsion system solutions for all types of vessels, compatible with diverse energy forms, supporting the shipping industry's zero-emission upgrade

solutions.title: Pure Electric Propulsion Solution
solutions.desc: The pure electric configuration is centered on battery power + electric propulsion systems, with propulsion energy independent of fuel generators. Through shore power replenishment or battery swapping, it meets operational scenarios with fixed routes, short-to-medium range, and high noise reduction requirements.

solutions.title: Series Hybrid Propulsion Solution
solutions.desc: This configuration uses an engine directly connected to the propulsion shaft as the main power path, while simultaneously arranging shaft-mounted motors (which can operate as motor/generator) on the shaft system, achieving 'engine direct propulsion, shaft power generation, and electric-assist combined propulsion' under different operating conditions.

solutions.title: Parallel Hybrid Propulsion Solution
solutions.desc: Engines and motors are connected in parallel to the propulsion chain, with propulsion torque coming from either engine direct drive, motor drive, or combined propulsion from both. The battery and power distribution system supply energy to the motors and ship loads, achieving comprehensive optimization of efficiency and comfort through energy management.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: Hanli New Energy (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. respects your privacy rights. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information.

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: Personal Identifiers: When you contact us or fill out forms, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, and other information.
Business Information: Information about your business, operational scenarios, and product requirements.
Usage Information: Information about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, and access times.
Communication Information: Any communications, inquiries, or feedback between you and us.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
content: Provide you with requested products and services
Respond to your inquiries and requests
Improve the quality of our website and services
Send you marketing information about our products, services, or special offers (if you have opted to receive such communications)
Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
Prevent fraud and protect website security

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
We may share information with:
• Service providers who perform business functions for us (such as email providers, data analytics providers)
• Law enforcement or government agencies, if required by law or to protect our rights
• Business partners, to provide you with joint products or services (with your consent)
• Successors or assignees, in the event of merger, acquisition, or asset sale

security.title: 4. Data Security
content: We implement reasonable technical, physical, and administrative measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
However, data transmission over the internet is not 100% secure. While we make every effort to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
content: We retain your information for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected and as required by law.
When information is no longer needed, we will delete or anonymize it.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
content: Right to Access: You have the right to request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Right to Correction: If you believe any information we hold about you is inaccurate, you can request correction.
Right to Deletion: In certain circumstances, you can request deletion of your personal information.
Right to Opt-Out: You can choose to opt out of receiving marketing communications.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
content: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your user experience.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain website functionality.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post any changes on our website and update the 'Last Updated' date where applicable.
